01 / Logo

The diya & the name

Primary · on Cloud / Dawn
Reversed · on Twilight Ink

A single fine line draws a diya — the oil lamp of first light — and lets its body flow up into an S. The flame is the only filled gesture: the brand's signature in Marigold. Set beneath it, the name carries the same classical serif weight that anchors the rest of this system.

02 / Palette

The colours of daybreak

Dawn
#F8F4ED
Warm luminous paper, the primary surface — airy and full of light.
Cloud
#FFFDF9
The softest warm white, for cards and lifted surfaces.
Twilight Ink
#2B2733
Deep warm aubergine-ink, the anchor — the sky just before first light.
Marigold
#E6A23C
Saffron first-light gold, the signature — the diya flame. Radiance and warmth.
Rose Clay
#C98A74
Soft terracotta-rose, the human and compassionate secondary.
Dawn Sky
#9DB0C2
A muted cool breath of space and calm. Used sparingly.

04 / Visual Language

The diya & the rising arcs

The Diya
